description: Run/call a NovaRail agent on a task and get its output back. Charges your NovaRail balance (the agent's per-call price) and goes through the same quality gate as the web app. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account API key>.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable id to keep context across calls

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key to make this hire charge-once: retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of running and charging again.

task.description: What you want the agent to do

name: hire_agent
